title: Telemetry record
description: What a provider reported about the execution of one task, under .ai/local/state/telemetry/: the measured facts of the work, each with the party that reported it. Majordomus invokes no model and so measures none of this itself; every number here was handed to it, and the record keeps who handed it. Absence is a value: a fact nobody reported is written as not_reported with the reason, never left out and never written as zero, so no reader can take a gap for a measurement. Nothing derived is stored (a total is arithmetic over these facts, done on every read), and nothing a session said or read has a field here.

schema.description: The format version of this record. A version the tool does not know is refused, never guessed.

task_id.description: The task whose execution the facts describe: the identity `majordomus start` allocated.

session_id.description: The episode the facts were reported in, when they belong to one.

recorded_at.description: When the record was written, UTC, RFC 3339. Not when the work happened: the provider's own clock is not a fact this record carries.

facts.description: The measured facts. Every one is present in every record, as a value or as an explicit absence: a record that omits a fact is refused, because an omitted key is exactly what a reader takes for zero.

input_uncached_tokens.description: Input tokens neither read from nor written to the provider's cache.

cache_write_tokens.description: Input tokens written to the provider's cache.

cache_read_tokens.description: Input tokens read from the provider's cache.

reasoning_tokens.description: The part of the output spent on reasoning, where the provider reports it apart.

cost_microusd.description: What the reporter says the work cost, in millionths of a US dollar. A harness's projection from its price table is a projection and a bill is a bill: the reporter says which, and neither is computed here.

Fact.description: One measured fact: a value somebody reported, or the explicit statement that nobody did. Exactly one of `value` and `not_reported`, and always a reporter.

value.description: The number, exactly as it was reported. Zero is a measurement: the reporter said zero.

not_reported.description: Why there is no value: the reason, in a sentence. Its presence is what says the fact is absent, and it is never read as zero.

reporter.description: The party the value came from, or the party that would have reported it and did not: a provider by its id in share/providers.yaml (claude-code, codex), or another named source. A fact with no reporter is refused.
